title: 什
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L141 什. Use these sentences exactly; spokenText equals text with punctuation removed. L141 depends on L139 卻 and L140 麼; do not merge production JSON until L139-L140 are present in latest origin/main. Provisional learned chars are 卻 and 麼. Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only; do not use Hanyu pinyin. 什麼 is allowed; 為什麼 is forbidden because 為 is not learned. S02 uses 我 as the mother speaking to the child, not the fixed first-person girl character. Images must use L058 style anchors and contain no text, numbers, zhuyin, labels, signs, letters, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio, processed through assets:audio and AI-aligned before production release.

approvedSentences.scene: A plate of vegetables looks too old and unpleasant to eat, with coarse fibers and less-fresh color, but not gross or scary. The visual focus is that the vegetables are too old.

approvedSentences.text: 我做了飯，你卻什麼也不吃。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 我做了飯你卻什麼也不吃
approvedSentences.scene: A mother has prepared rice for a child, but the child refuses to eat anything. In this sentence, 我 means the mother speaking to the child, not the fixed first-person girl. Show the mother's cooked rice and the child's refusing or not-eating body language. No dialogue text.

approvedSentences.text: 外面大雨，老太太卻要出門。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 外面大雨老太太卻要出門
approvedSentences.scene: Outside it is raining heavily, yet an elderly woman is getting ready to go out. Show a doorway, rainy weather, and the elderly woman preparing to step outside, making the contrast clear.
A child is reading a book while someone nearby is curious about what book the child is reading. The book must not show readable text, title, letters, labels, or symbols.

Seen from inside a doorway toward outside, a person is standing outside the door while someone indoors is curious about who that person is. Make it clear there is a person outside the door. No house number, sign, label, or text.
